metric_m2.definition: M2 (frozen-safe): drop drift-corrected ratios whose neighbour baseline mean is < 0.5 fps (frozen denominator — no speed information), then take the MEDIAN of the remaining ratios; valid iff >=3 ratios remain. Frozen deint numerators (ratio 0.0) are KEPT — a stalled deint slot is signal, not artefact. Implemented as g5FrozenSafeFromReport() in deint-fps-verdict-83k3.mjs (new, with 5 regression tests). G5 is UNCHANGED — M2 is a parallel metric, not a replacement (parent decision).

metric_m2.why_two_inflation_modes: Mode A (frozen denominator): W6 e1-run1 ratio 4.27x from neighbour 0.15 fps -> G5 1.82x, M2 1.00x. Exclusion alone fixes only A; median alone fixes only B; M2 does both.
